name: Yi Weihua
current_role: Co-founder and controlling shareholder, WG Tech (Jiangxi WG Optoelectronic, 603773.SH); stepped down as chairman and director in March 2026
profile: Yi Weihua (易伟华) co-founded WG Tech (沃格光电) in Xinyu, Jiangxi in December 2009 with Zhang Fujia. It started in flat-panel display glass processing, listed on the Shanghai main board in 2018, and is now pivoting to glass circuit boards (GCP) for Mini LED and semiconductor packaging. He left the board in March 2026 'for personal reasons', and Zhang Chunjiao became chairman.
interesting_fact: Yi has a technical background, and since 2019 he has personally led WG Tech's R&D push into glass-substrate circuit boards (TGV/GCP) for Mini LED backlights and advanced chip packaging. That puts the company in the glass-core substrate race relevant to AI and data-center chips.
deep_cut_fact: After graduating from university in 1996, Yi started as a technician in Shenzhen and rose to manager and trader. In 2006 he started his own touch-screen sales business before founding WG Tech. He has said he wanted to 'gather a group of young people with dreams, character and ability to come together to do things that are meaningful to society.'
notes: No longer chairman (resigned March 2026); Zhang Chunjiao (listed as sharing this wealth entry) is now chairman. In May 2026 the CSRC opened an investigation into a share-transfer disclosure, and he was fined in August 2026. Treat as sensitive and approach via company IR.

name: Lu Xiaofu
current_role: Listed by Hurun as a Nongfu Spring executive/shareholder; exact title not found in public filings
profile: Lu Xiaofu (卢晓芙) has been on Hurun China lists since 2020, with wealth tied to Nongfu Spring (9633.HK), the Hangzhou beverage group controlled by Zhong Shanshan. Hangzhou press coverage of the 2025 Hurun list names her among several Nongfu Spring executives on it. She does not appear in the director or shareholder disclosures we checked.
interesting_fact: Hurun's 2025 coverage of Hangzhou's rich list names her among the Nongfu Spring executives on the list. That year Zhong Shanshan topped the Hurun China list for a fourth time, at RMB 530bn.
notes: Very low public profile. Her role and holding are not disclosed in HKEX filings (not a director or a substantial shareholder). Hurun hints at family ties within the Nongfu circle, but this is unverified. The only route is via Nongfu Spring IR.
